name: n_std
description: balanced metabolites: bounds exp(mu +/- n_std * sigma) of ln C over the conditions (3 contains every measured value)

name: cofactor_slack
description: cofactors: measured range widened by this fraction on each side

name: drain_widen
description: free drains: measured range widened by this fraction of its span on each side

name: floor
description: smallest lower bound of a concentration (mM)

name: pi_lo
description: lower bound of C_pi (mM); Pi is not measured so a physiological range is used
